limits.old_pool: First 81 frames of old train/val episodes; all 325 frames of previously inspected old test episodes, from both damping files. All contiguous windows in this pool (a conservative superset of actual training starts).
limits.checks: Exact float64 initial states, full physical-state/float32-action trajectories, initial 4/5 RGB frames, initial 13/14 RGB-plus-action training-length payloads. SHA256 indexes with witnesses.
limits.limits: No near-duplicate guarantee; no claim that every future RGB window is absent from old data. Similar states and shared rendered equilibrium frames are expected in low-dimensional deterministic physics. Deduplicated subsets are filtered distributions, not the raw sampling distribution.
limits.distribution_audit: Save mode counts and initial |theta|, |omega|, and energy quantiles before and after filtering.
